row3_cohort.use: Consumed Development mechanism test only after validation-family model selection.

source.contract: Use only already materialized 3RScan sequence, pose, depth, and provider instance geometry assets.

masker.contract: Frozen exact target boxes prompt one local SAM2 mask per positive view; depth and pose lift the mask into a partial 3D observation.

observation.contract: Create single-, two-, and three-view partial observations only within one scan coordinate system.

training.initial_behavior: Zero final layer means the first prediction is exactly the observed partial extent.
training.selection: Select one checkpoint only by mean planar rectangle IoU over the four identity-disjoint validation identities. Row3 is unavailable during selection.

decision: If the target-disjoint validation mean improves and the frozen head reaches action-view IoU at least 0.8 on consumed row3, freeze the same head and action selector for a new source-family confirmation. Otherwise close this learned extent parameterization and inspect the measured error mode before changing it.
claim_boundary: This is Development evidence for completing a portal plane extent from SAM-RGBD observations. Full instance geometry is training/evaluation supervision only. Row3 is already consumed and cannot provide fresh confirmation. A positive result is not portal ownership, access, waypoint, arrival, handoff, user benefit, reliability, or safety evidence.
